title: 《末班车》
previous_titles: 第一话 · 八点半的火车
english_summary: Closing time, rain, and a phone left on a table. The old man who forgot it needs the last train to reach his wife in a distant hospital. You and 阿力 race across town with four minutes to spare.
_content_comment: One beat per line, 'NAME：text' with a fullwidth colon. Beat indices are 0-based and are what panels[].bubbles[].beat refers to; INSERTING A LINE MEANS RE-INDEXING THE PANELS.
content:
晚上八点，外面在下雨。
饭馆里没有人了。
阿力：你看，桌子上有一个手机！
你：是那个爷爷的！他已经走了。
阿力：他要去火车站，他的车八点半开！
阿力：没有手机，他不能给奶奶打电话。
你：奶奶怎么了？
阿力：她生病了，要进医院，在等他。
你：我们打车去！
你：我们跑过去！
阿力：好！我叫车！
阿力：好！你跑得快，你走前面！
外面雨很大，路上没有车。
阿力：快！快要八点半了！
阿力：手机在唱歌！
你：喂？你是谁？
奶奶：我是他妻子。爷爷在哪儿？
你：我们在找他！奶奶，你在哪儿？
奶奶：我在医院，离这儿很远。他在等我吗？
你：他在等你！我们也快到了！
火车站。八点二十六分。
门口有很多人，我们看不见他。
阿力：人太多了！我们怎么找他？
你：我个子高，我进去找！
你：你去那边，我去这边！
你：爷爷！爷爷！你的手机！
爷爷：我的手机！谢谢你们，好孩子！
爷爷：你们怎么来的？
你：我们跑来的。奶奶在医院等你。
他的眼睛里有水。
爷爷：这是今天最后的火车。
爷爷：我的妻子还在医院等我。
火车开了。爷爷上去了。
他在火车上打电话。
阿力：明天早上八点，你有考试！
你：我知道。但是我们做对了。
晚上十点，雨不下了。
阿力：他现在到医院了吗？
你：他已经到了。
阿力：奶奶现在很高兴。
我们笑了，一起走回家。
english_content:
Eight in the evening. Outside, it is raining.
There is nobody left in the restaurant.
Look — there's a phone on the table!
It's that grandpa's! He's already gone.
He's going to the train station. His train leaves at eight-thirty!
Without the phone, he can't call Grandma.
What's wrong with Grandma?
She's ill. She's going into hospital, and she's waiting for him.
We'll get a taxi!
We'll run there!
OK! I'll call a car!
OK! You're fast — you go in front!
The rain is heavy out there, and there are no cars on the road.
Quick! It's almost eight-thirty!
The phone is singing!
Hello? Who are you?
I'm his wife. Where is Grandpa?
We're looking for him! Grandma, where are you?
I'm in a hospital far from here. Is he waiting for me?
He's waiting for you! We're almost there too!
The train station. Eight twenty-six.
There are so many people at the entrance that we can't see him.
Too many people! How do we find him?
I'm tall — I'll go in and look!
You go that way, I'll go this way!
Grandpa! Grandpa! Your phone!
My phone! Thank you, good kids!
How did you get here?
We ran. Grandma is waiting for you at the hospital.
There was water in his eyes.
This is the last train today.
My wife is still waiting for me in hospital.
The train left. Grandpa boarded.
He is making a call on the train.
Tomorrow morning at eight, you have an exam!
I know. But we did the right thing.
Ten at night. The rain has stopped.
Has he reached the hospital now?
He has already arrived.
Grandma must be very happy now.
We laughed and walked home together.
_vocabulary_comment: Every word is HSK 2 (data/hsk2-vocab-snapshot.json, cumulative). Zero reach words; the only non-word token is the curated name 阿力. The level's gaps shaped the writing: 响 is absent, so the incoming call is the phone 唱歌 — which also gives the art its best recurring image, a little glowing rectangle singing in the rain. 刚 is absent, so he 已经走了. 窗户 is absent, so the farewell is 他在火车上打电话 instead of a face at a window. 北京 is absent too (place words are not curriculum), so Grandma is 离这儿很远 — farther away raises the stakes better than a pin on a map.

questions.question: Why did the learner and 阿力 hurry to the station?
options: To return Grandpa's phone before his train left

questions.question: What happened after Grandpa got his phone?
options: He caught the last train and called his wife
He walked home with the children

panels.alt: Night rain over a small family restaurant, warm light spilling from the window onto the wet street, one empty table visible inside with chairs already turned up.
Close on a smartphone lying alone on a wiped table, its screen lighting up the wood grain; 阿力's hand points in from the edge of frame.
阿力 with rain on his hair, urgently holding up eight fingers then two, the restaurant clock behind him reading eight ten.
A quieter beat: 阿力's face gone serious in the warm shop light, explaining, while the reader holds the phone between them.
A letterbox of the empty drowned street: no cars anywhere, two small figures bursting out of the restaurant doorway into sheets of rain.
Extreme close-up of the phone glowing and buzzing in a wet hand, music notes of light rising off the screen into the dark rain.
Soft cool light: 奶奶 sitting up in a hospital bed by a high window of city lights, a folded coat on the chair beside her, phone at her ear.
Two kids sprinting full-tilt toward the lit station at the end of the road, reflections racing under their feet, the phone held high like a torch.
The station clock reading eight twenty-six above a dense crowd of umbrellas and shoulders streaming through the entrance.
From the kids' eye level: a wall of legs, bags and umbrellas, not a single face visible; 阿力 on tiptoe at the edge of frame.
High over the crowd, one arm and phone thrust up, mouth wide in a shout; beyond the shoulders, a grey-coated old man turning toward the sound.
The old man clutching the phone to his chest with both hands, bowing his head to the two soaked kids, station light haloing all three.
The tightest close-up of the episode: the old man's eyes shining, one tear catching the station light, his mouth halfway to a smile.
The train pulling out in a blur of lit windows; in one window the old man sits with the phone at his ear, raising his other hand to the platform.
Late-night calm: the two kids walking home down the middle of the wet empty road, rain thinning to nothing, streetlights doubled in the puddles.
Late-night calm: the two kids walking home down the middle of the wet empty road, rain thinning to nothing, streetlights doubled in the puddles.
The restaurant doorway again, dark now; the two kids stopped under the eaves looking at each other, the question hanging between them.
Final plate: the dark restaurant window from outside, one small light still on behind the glass, rain-washed street empty — tomorrow night already waiting inside.
